'''kingkalit jawa deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[kingkalit]]
* '''Published:''' 17 February 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif|label=Agents In The Court}}
* '''Strategy:''' Agents In The Court
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor Court kingkalit LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

it force drains and has jawas. not one of my stronger decks, please sumbmit only pointers on improving, i really don't care about rating.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

use vapor's text to drain with vaporators and hydros. i played and wone once against a set your course for alderaan deck, but i dont think it would fair well against a court of the vile gangster or my kind of scum decks, so please submit help.
